correctness.rationale: Complete vertex classification via mutually exclusive active prefix/coordinate inequalities holds for every strictly positive increment vector. The split by last positive coordinate and nonnegative disjoint-support bound proves the maximum and unique attaining pair. A separate rational checker exhaustively enumerates finite samples and supports but does not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The formula exactly resolves a natural Euclidean invariant of all standard Pitman–Stanley polytopes with positive real increments and identifies a unique diametral pair across exponentially many vertices. The unit-increment second largest distinct squared vertex-distance layer supplies an independently meaningful metric gap and complete pair multiplicity rather than an arbitrary computed case; these are not part of the classic volume/Ehrhart/face data. The precise realization and limits are explicit.
